# InteractionProcessContext

An interaction run's conversation, grouped by kind of item. Every item has a `sequence`: merge the lists and sort by it to read the conversation in order.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `agentMessage` | [`InteractionProcessContextAgentMessage`](interaction-process-context-agent-message.md)`[]` | What the agents said. |
| `agree` | [`InteractionProcessContextAgree`](interaction-process-context-agree.md)`[]` | Votes for a vote proposal or a proposed final answer. |
| `directQuestionAnswer` | [`InteractionProcessContextDirectQuestionAnswer`](interaction-process-context-direct-question-answer.md)`[]` | Answers to questions one agent asked another directly. |
| `directQuestionAsk` | [`InteractionProcessContextDirectQuestionAsk`](interaction-process-context-direct-question-ask.md)`[]` | Questions one agent asked another directly. |
| `disagree` | [`InteractionProcessContextDisagree`](interaction-process-context-disagree.md)`[]` | Votes against a vote proposal or a proposed final answer, with the reasons. |
| `humanMessage` | [`InteractionProcessContextHumanMessage`](interaction-process-context-human-message.md)`[]` | Messages people sent to the run. |
| `injectedSystemMessage` | [`InteractionProcessContextInjectedSystemMessage`](interaction-process-context-injected-system-message.md)`[]` | System messages added to the run while it was going. |
| `noAction` | [`InteractionProcessContextNoAction`](interaction-process-context-no-action.md)`[]` | Turns an agent passed without saying anything. |
| `orchestratorMessage` | [`InteractionProcessContextOrchestratorMessage`](interaction-process-context-orchestrator-message.md)`[]` | Messages from Maitento running the conversation, such as handing an agent its turn. |
| `solutionProposal` | [`InteractionProcessContextSolutionProposal`](interaction-process-context-solution-proposal.md)`[]` | Final answers the agents proposed. |
| `systemPrompt` | [`InteractionProcessContextSystemPrompt`](interaction-process-context-system-prompt.md)`[]` | System prompts the agents were given. |
| `toolCall` | [`InteractionProcessContextToolCall`](interaction-process-context-tool-call.md)`[]` | Tool calls the agents made. |
| `toolResult` | [`InteractionProcessContextToolResult`](interaction-process-context-tool-result.md)`[]` | The results of the agents' tool calls. |
| `voteProposal` | [`InteractionProcessContextVoteProposal`](interaction-process-context-vote-proposal.md)`[]` | Things the agents put to a vote. |
| `summary` | [`InteractionProcessContextSummary`](interaction-process-context-summary.md)`[]` | Summaries of the earlier conversation, written when it neared the model's context window. |
